root_cause.text: The `get_upper_ifindexes()` function in the BPF devmap subsystem failed to enforce bounds checking while populating a stack-allocated array with upper device indices, allowing writes beyond the array boundary when the number of upper devices exceeded the expected limit.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states the function "writes their indices into an array without checking bounds," and the patch adds a `max` parameter with a check `if (n >= max)` to prevent writing past the `excluded_devices` array when upper device counts exceed `MAX_NEST_DEV`.
